# CLI reference

Generated from the command registry. Every command accepts `--json`.

## `sqy version`

Show framework, Python and platform versions.

## `sqy doctor`

Check the environment, dependencies, cache and credentials.

## `sqy commands`

List commands, reason codes and exit codes.

## `sqy schema`

List bundled JSON schemas, or print one.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `name` | schema name (omit to list them) |

## `sqy explain`

Explain a reason code and how to resolve it.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `code` | reason code, e.g. HOLDOUT_REUSED |

## `sqy init`

Create a new strategy project.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `path` | new project directory |
| `--upgrade-agents-md` | refresh the framework-owned blocks of an existing project's AGENTS.md |
| `--project` | project directory for --upgrade-agents-md |
| `--demo` | use synthetic data (no credentials needed) |
| `--lab` | a multi-family strategy lab (per-family ledgers) |
| `--kind` | starter: equity trend, options wheel, or factor demo (requires --demo) (one of `equity`, `options`, `factor`) |
| `--package` | Python package name for strategies (default: from the directory name) |

## `sqy check`

Run conformance, determinism and look-ahead checks.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--strategy` | check only this strategy id |
| `--factor` | check one project module defining a @factor function |
| `--factor-id` | check a factor id registered in signalquarry.toml |
| `--params-json` | JSON object of factor parameters |
| `--parity` | also replay 60 sessions through the paper kernel and a fake venue; must match the backtest |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from cwd) |

## `sqy factor`

List factors or calculate unverified descriptive diagnostics.

### `sqy factor ls`

List explicitly registered project factors and hashes.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards) |

### `sqy factor evaluate`

Compute descriptive, unverified diagnostics from selected local manifests.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--factor` | registered factor ID (required) |
| `--dataset-id` | locally recorded dataset manifest ID |
| `--universe-manifest` | dated universe build manifest path; repeat for each decision session |
| `--synthetic` | use an offline synthetic panel without manifests |
| `--symbols` | synthetic panel symbol count (default: 200) |
| `--seed` | synthetic panel random seed (default: 7) |
| `--planted-ic` | synthetic signal loading (default: 0.05) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards) |

## `sqy data`

Fetch, verify and list recorded market data.

### `sqy data fetch`

Download daily bars and corporate actions and record a manifest.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--strategy` | fetch the symbols (and benchmark) of this strategy |
| `--symbols` | comma-separated extra symbols |
| `--start` | first date (default 2016-01-01) |
| `--end` | last date (default yesterday) |
| `--feed` | default: the strategy's feed, else sip (one of `sip`, `iex`) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from cwd) |

### `sqy data capture-actions`

Record all corporate-action categories in the private cache.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--symbols` | comma-separated uppercase symbols (required) |
| `--start` | first process date (required) |
| `--end` | last process date (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from cwd) |

### `sqy data probe`

Check provider coverage: expired option contracts and their bars.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `what` | what to probe (one of `options-coverage`) |
| `--underlying` | underlying symbol |
| `--month` | expiration month to probe, YYYY-MM (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from cwd) |

### `sqy data record`

Record today's option chain for an underlying (raw pages cached, hash-only record).

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `what` | what to record (one of `options`) |
| `--underlying` | underlying symbol, e.g. QQQ (required) |
| `--max-dte` | latest expiration, in days from today |
| `--width` | strike window around spot, as a fraction |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from cwd) |

### `sqy data verify`

Re-hash cached pages against every manifest.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from cwd) |

### `sqy data ls`

List recorded datasets.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from cwd) |

## `sqy universe`

Build and verify point-in-time common-stock universes.

### `sqy universe snapshot`

Capture the full current Alpaca US-equity asset list.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from cwd) |

### `sqy universe verify`

Verify hashed asset snapshots against cached raw pages.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from cwd) |

### `sqy universe as-of`

Find a verified snapshot known by a UTC cutoff.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--known-at` | timezone-aware decision cutoff (ISO 8601); older than 31 days is unavailable (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from cwd) |

### `sqy universe build`

Build one dated common-stock universe from verified as-of inputs.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--session` | decision session (YYYY-MM-DD) (required) |
| `--known-at` | timezone-aware cutoff before the decision session (ISO 8601) (required) |
| `--dataset-id` | verified Alpaca dataset manifest ID (required) |
| `--classification-file` | dated JSON security-master snapshot keyed by stable asset UUID (required) |
| `--minimum-price` | minimum prior-session close in USD (required) |
| `--minimum-listing-age-days` | minimum listing age at the decision session (required) |
| `--minimum-dollar-volume-percentile` | minimum 20-session median dollar-volume percentile (0-100) (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from cwd) |

## `sqy spec`

Freeze a strategy configuration (spec freeze).

### `sqy spec freeze`

Freeze the configuration and seal the family's holdout.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--strategy` | strategy id from strategy.yaml (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |

## `sqy evaluate`

Walk-forward, stress and holdout gates; sets the claim level.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--strategy` | strategy id from strategy.yaml (required) |
| `--no-stress` | skip the cost and delay stress reruns |
| `--holdout` | open the sealed holdout (once per family; needs G1-G3) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |

## `sqy trials`

List trials or (humans only) extend a family's budget.

### `sqy trials ls`

List recorded trials.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--family` | strategy family |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |

### `sqy trials show`

Show entries by sequence number or configuration-hash prefix.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `key` | sequence number or configuration-hash prefix |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |

### `sqy trials extend`

HUMAN ONLY: add 10 trials to a family's budget.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--family` | strategy family (required) |
| `--reason` | why; recorded in the evidence log (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |

## `sqy holdout`

Seal a family's holdout early, or show seals and openings.

### `sqy holdout status`

Show each family's holdout seal and opening.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |

### `sqy holdout seal`

## `sqy sweep`

|---|---|
| `--strategy` | strategy id from strategy.yaml (required) |
| `--param` | NAME=V1,V2,… (repeatable) (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |

## `sqy backtest`

Backtest a strategy and write run artifacts.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--strategy` | strategy id from strategy.yaml (required) |
| `--start` | first session (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `--end` | last session (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from cwd) |

## `sqy evidence`

Verify evidence ledgers, journals and bundles; export a family's evidence bundle.

### `sqy evidence verify`

Verify evidence ledgers and paper journals, or an exported bundle (--bundle).

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--base` | git ref; fail if any log changed other than by appending since it |
| `--bundle` | verify this exported evidence bundle directory instead |
| `--max-tier` | highest tier the bundle may carry (one of `public`, `nda`) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |

### `sqy evidence export`

Export a family's evidence bundle under its publication policy.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--family` | strategy family (required) |
| `--tier` | public (showcase) or nda (data room) (one of `public`, `nda`) |
| `--out` | output directory (default: .signalquarry/exports/...) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |

## `sqy commit`

Salted commitments to frozen strategies and journal heads (OpenTimestamps).

### `sqy commit create`

Commit to a frozen strategy (salted) or to a paper journal head.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--strategy` | strategy id from strategy.yaml (required) |
| `--alias` | commit to this paper deployment's journal head instead |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |

### `sqy commit reveal`

Write the private opening of a spec commitment (NDA only).

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--id` | commitment id (required) |
| `--out` | where to write the opening (mode 0600) (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |

### `sqy commit verify`

Check an opening against a commitment record.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--record` | commitment record JSON (required) |
| `--reveal` | opening JSON from `sqy commit reveal` (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |

Paper performance snapshots: private captures, or a public feed (live_feed: allow).

|---|---|

| `--out` | feed directory, e.g. site/public/feeds/paper (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |

### `sqy perf capture`

Record a private, hash-chained snapshot under paper/ALIAS/captures/.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--alias` | paper deployment alias (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |

## `sqy docs`

|---|---|

## `sqy paper`

Alpaca paper forward tests: preflight, dry-run, run-once, status, halt.

### `sqy paper preflight`

Read-only readiness checks for a deployment.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--alias` | deployment alias (the ALIAS in paper/ALIAS.paper.yaml) (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |

### `sqy paper dry-run`

Decide and size the next session without submitting anything.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--alias` | deployment alias (the ALIAS in paper/ALIAS.paper.yaml) (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |

### `sqy paper arm`

HUMAN ONLY: allow a deployment to submit paper orders (interactive confirmation).

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--alias` | deployment alias (the ALIAS in paper/ALIAS.paper.yaml) (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |
| `--reason` | recorded in the journal (required) |

### `sqy paper run-once`

Reconcile, decide and submit the current session's orders (idempotent).

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--alias` | deployment alias (the ALIAS in paper/ALIAS.paper.yaml) (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |
| `--notify-command` | absolute executable path; called on a non-zero run-once exit with no credential environment |

### `sqy paper status`

Show the journal state: armed/halted, sessions, pending orders.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--alias` | deployment alias (the ALIAS in paper/ALIAS.paper.yaml) (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |

### `sqy paper capture-activities`

Read-only private capture of paper account activities by creation time.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--alias` | deployment alias (the ALIAS in paper/ALIAS.paper.yaml) (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |
| `--created-after` | activity creation time with UTC offset (required) |
| `--created-until` | later creation time with UTC offset (required) |

### `sqy paper verify-activities`

Re-hash a private paper activity capture without contacting Alpaca.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--alias` | deployment alias (the ALIAS in paper/ALIAS.paper.yaml) (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |
| `--capture` | private capture hash (required) |

### `sqy paper observe-activities`

Normalize a private activity capture without interpreting economic terms.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--alias` | deployment alias (the ALIAS in paper/ALIAS.paper.yaml) (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |
| `--capture` | private capture hash (required) |

### `sqy paper verify-observations`

Rebuild private activity observations from captured pages offline.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--alias` | deployment alias (the ALIAS in paper/ALIAS.paper.yaml) (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |
| `--observation` | private observation hash (required) |

### `sqy paper compare-observations`

Compare private observations from the same account and creation window.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--alias` | deployment alias (the ALIAS in paper/ALIAS.paper.yaml) (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |
| `--left` | earlier private observation hash (required) |
| `--right` | later private observation hash (required) |

### `sqy paper reconcile`

Finalize journaled orders and check positions against the broker.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--alias` | deployment alias (the ALIAS in paper/ALIAS.paper.yaml) (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |

### `sqy paper halt`

Stop a deployment and cancel its open orders; a human re-arms.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--alias` | deployment alias (the ALIAS in paper/ALIAS.paper.yaml) (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |
| `--reason` | recorded in the journal (required) |

### `sqy paper drift`

Replay sessions against the engine, measure fill slippage, apply model costs; gate G5.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--alias` | deployment alias (the ALIAS in paper/ALIAS.paper.yaml) (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |

### `sqy paper run`

Run run-once until done, retrying while busy or unavailable (for a service manager).

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--alias` | deployment alias (the ALIAS in paper/ALIAS.paper.yaml) (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |
| `--interval` | seconds between retries |
| `--max-minutes` | give up after this long |

### `sqy paper backup`

Write a tar.gz of the journal and arm token with a hash manifest.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--alias` | deployment alias (the ALIAS in paper/ALIAS.paper.yaml) (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |
| `--out` | directory (default: .signalquarry/backups/ALIAS) |

### `sqy paper verify-continuity`

Check the live journal extends a backup (no rollback on the host).

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--alias` | deployment alias (the ALIAS in paper/ALIAS.paper.yaml) (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |
| `--backup` | a tar.gz written by paper backup (required) |

### `sqy paper schedule`

Write scheduler templates (systemd, launchd, cron, github-actions) for review.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--alias` | deployment alias (the ALIAS in paper/ALIAS.paper.yaml) (required) |
| `--project` | project directory (default: search upwards from the current directory) |
| `--target` | scheduler to write templates for (github-actions is demo-only) (required; one of `systemd`, `launchd`, `cron`, `github-actions`) |
| `--notify-command` | absolute executable path; called on a non-zero run-once exit with no credential environment |
